sites.name: pulse-displacement-distance

replacements.name: scalar-origin-minus-position
temporary-vector-length
replacements.text:
float pulse_scale = projectile_render_vec2_t(
                    projectile->pos.origin_x - projectile->pos_x,
                    primary->origin_y - projectile->pos.pos_y).length()
                    * 0.01f;

replacements.name: named-vector-length
direct-vector-difference-length
replacements.text:
float pulse_scale = (
                    projectile_render_vec2_t(
                        projectile->pos.origin_x, primary->origin_y)
                    - projectile_render_vec2_t(
                        projectile->pos_x, projectile->pos.pos_y)).length()
                    * 0.01f;
